Of the 53 remaining items, the best question is one that splits them close to half and half.

"Can you hold it in one hand?" looks promising. Items that fit in one hand: ball, book, camera, candle, coin, glasses, hammer, key, knife, mug, pencil, phone, scissors, stapler, toothbrush, shoe, light bulb, bread, cheese, chocolate, ice cream, and some others. That is roughly 25 of the 53, which is nearly even.
